parts.name: Lamp Head
parts.Basic_description: This is the lamp head, a spherical component made of glass, typically enclosing the light bulb.
parts.Functional_description: It diffuses and directs the light emitted from the bulb, providing illumination and aesthetic appeal.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in position and does not move independently; it is attached to the chain or support structure.

parts.name: Chain
parts.Basic_description: This is the chain of the lamp, a slender metallic component used to suspend the lamp head from the ceiling.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the weight of the lamp head and allows for height adjustment or hanging stability.
parts.Movement_description: It can move slightly due to flexibility and swinging motion but remains anchored at the top.
